Deficiencies of minerals (iron, iodine, zinc, calcium, phosphorus, magnesium,
copper, potassium, sodium, chloride, fluoride etc); folic acid and vitamins
Aetiology
- Inadequate dietary intake
- Increased requirements
- Increased loss (e.g. worm infestation)
Epidemiology
- Global; high prevalence in under-developed countries, especially sub-
Saharan Africa
